templates.title: Indelible
templates.name: indelible
templates.description: Indelible is a self-hosted read-it-later and knowledge library. It stores articles, newsletters, PDFs, and EPUBs in PostgreSQL and an S3-compatible object store, and the API serves the web app on the same port.

env.name: IND_ENV
env.label: IND_ENV
env.description: Local trial mode. Production requires an https IND_BASE_URL and refuses plain HTTP.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.label: DATABASE_URL
env.description: PostgreSQL connection string for the postgres service. The database must provide pgvector.

env.name: S3_ENDPOINT
env.label: S3_ENDPOINT
env.description: S3-compatible endpoint for the bundled Silo service.

env.name: S3_REGION
env.label: S3_REGION
env.description: Region sent to Silo.

env.name: S3_BUCKET
env.label: S3_BUCKET
env.description: Bucket created by indelible-silo-init.

env.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY
env.label: S3_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Silo access key. Matches MINIO_ROOT_USER.

env.name: S3_SECRET_KEY
env.label: S3_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Silo secret. Matches MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.

env.name: S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
env.label: S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
env.description: Path-style URLs, required for Silo.

env.name: AUTH_CREDENTIAL_KEY
env.label: AUTH_CREDENTIAL_KEY
env.description: Base64 of 32 random bytes. Must be identical on the API and worker.

env.name: EGRESS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS
env.label: EGRESS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS
env.description: Keep the SSRF guard closed. Set true only to reach an AI server on the host.

env.name: IND_HOST
env.label: IND_HOST
env.description: API bind address.

env.name: IND_PORT
env.label: IND_PORT
env.description: Port the published API image listens on.

env.name: IND_BASE_URL
env.label: IND_BASE_URL
env.description: Public URL of this instance for the local trial.

env.name: FRONTEND_URL
env.label: FRONTEND_URL
env.description: Web origin. Must match IND_BASE_URL.

env.name: CORS_ORIGINS
env.label: CORS_ORIGINS
env.description: Origins allowed to refresh a session.

env.name: EXTENSION_REDIRECT_URIS
env.label: EXTENSION_REDIRECT_URIS
env.description: Browser extension identity callbacks from the v0.1.1 local compose.

env.name: JWT_SECRET
env.label: JWT_SECRET
env.description: Signs session tokens.

env.name: CSRF_SECRET
env.label: CSRF_SECRET
env.description: CSRF secret.

env.name: ASSET_COOKIE_SECRET
env.label: ASSET_COOKIE_SECRET
env.description: 64 hex characters. Signs short-lived asset cookies.

env.name: OIDC_ENABLED
env.label: OIDC_ENABLED
env.description: Leave false unless OIDC issuer, client id, and client secret are set.

env.name: RENDERER_HOST
env.label: RENDERER_HOST
env.description: Renderer bind address.

env.name: RENDERER_PORT
env.label: RENDERER_PORT
env.description: Renderer listen port on the compose network.

env.name: RENDERER_URL
env.label: RENDERER_URL
env.description: Worker address for the renderer service.

env.name: POSTGRES_USER
env.label: POSTGRES_USER
env.description: PostgreSQL user.

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.description: PostgreSQL password. Must match DATABASE_URL.

env.name: POSTGRES_DB
env.label: POSTGRES_DB
env.description: PostgreSQL database name.

env.name: MINIO_ROOT_USER
env.label: MINIO_ROOT_USER
env.description: Silo root user.

env.name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
env.label: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
env.description: Silo root password. Must match S3_SECRET_KEY. indelible-silo-init reads this environment value, so change it here rather than in the command.
